messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.

Lisa Freeman ran the third week of Financial Triage Navigator sessions and compiled the first utilization report: 14 total sessions conducted since launch, 11 participants left with a specific prioritized next step, 6 referred to Kevin O'Brien's office hours, 4 referred to retraining programs, 3 referred to the community college pathway, and 4 presented needs no existing Millfield resource currently addresses — the unmet-needs category she will use in every future funding conversation. Nicole Washington agreed to sit at a corner table during the next Community Connection Night for drop-in conversations about healthcare credential pathways, a concrete bounded ask she accepted without hesitation. Mark Thompson contacted Lisa the same day the board voted yes on his program, and together they drafted a one-paragraph written description of how the Auto Tech Pipeline and the Financial Triage Navigator cross-refer the same population — now printed in both organizations' handout materials. Lisa sent Santos the utilization aggregate counts with a single-paragraph cover note; Santos responded the same day acknowledging the report and asking Lisa to flag the unmet-needs category at the next task force session.
